title: Cavernous Unearthed
description: This mod adds vanilla style cave biomes and features.
body:
# Cavernous
Cavernous Unearthed is a vanilla style mod that adds many new cave biomes and cave related features. Right now it is in early snapshot phases but I will consistently be working on new content until it is ready to release fully.

# Current Features
-Fungal Caves Biome
-Volcanic Caves Biome
